```python
def test_app_rows_survive_render_then_import(tmp_path):
    """render → import must not lose the APP half. Before this, an APP row came
    back as `malformed-row` (11 columns, expected 8) and `import` exited 2."""
    store = tmp_path / "backlog"
    BACKLOG.import_legacy(
        _table("| IMP-0001 | 2026-06-13 | a | doc | low | fixed | first | — |"), store
    )
    BACKLOG.add_entry(
        store,
        stream="APP",
        date="2026-08-05",
        source="dogfood",
        category="ux",
        severity="high",
        status="open",
        detail="tapping a word mid-layout selects the wrong token",
        surface="reader",
        repro="open reader, rotate, tap",
    )

    rendered = BACKLOG.render_view(store, verified_against="deadbeef")
    _, problems = BACKLOG.parse_legacy_table(rendered)
    assert [p for p in problems if p["kind"] == "malformed-row"] == [], problems

    doc = tmp_path / "view.md"
    doc.write_text(rendered, encoding="utf-8")
    assert BACKLOG.main(
        ["import", "--store", str(tmp_path / "s2"), "--from", str(doc), "--commit"]
    ) == 0
```
